cover.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create a finished illustrated literary comedy book cover for the short story "No Comment", portrait 9:16, 864x1536. Exact title text, rendered ONCE as part of the painting: "No Comment". Large very legible blue hand-painted lettering in the upper quarter, two lines if useful. No author name or extra slogan.

Reference image is STYLE ONLY: rhythmic Canadian Group of Seven inspired oil painting, broad opaque colour/value shapes, varied directional brushstrokes, connected deep shadows, selective impasto, simplified faces and architecture, quiet connecting passages. Do not copy the orchard scene. Avoid glossy rendering, uniform bevelled marks, theatrical rim lighting, automatic orange/blue contrast.

Finished-story subject: Marnie, an ordinary adult woman public-relations manager for three magical girls, wants to stay behind the camera. Interpret her visually as in her early forties, warm light-olive skin, short wavy dark-brown bob with a little grey at temples, expressive practical face. She wears a charcoal blazer over a cream blouse, charcoal trousers and sensible flat black lace-up shoes. She holds an ordinary clipboard and a small black comb, looking ruefully composed in a situation escaping her control. Show full figure, readable strong silhouette, fully clothed, modest everyday professional clothing.

Novel-cover composition, not a plot diagram: Marnie is the large central figure outside a small neighbourhood bakery with fresh front window, muted sage awning, and sunlit cream stone pavement. A generous spill of crimson and dusty pink rescue roses crowds her sensible shoes. Three adult magical-girl teammates are small, softly simplified background figures: one with a tidy plait and white boots, one in a red cape, one in green. They look fondly toward their manager; no weapons, no threatening stance. A fluffy white cat-sized sugarwing pastry thief with comically small wings and a narrow drinking-straw mouth peeks near a cinnamon pastry at the edge. Warm, dry, affectionate workplace farce. The title and clipboard should anchor the cover; leave breathing room around title, keep background subordinate. Natural late-morning sunlight and muted cream, sage, charcoal, rose and red. No manga/anime styling, no photoreal faces, no collage panels, no other legible text.
cover.correction_prompt:
Edit the supplied cover with ONE precise correction. Keep its beautiful painterly composition, all people and identities, costumes, clipboard, comb, shoes, roses, bakery, colors, brushwork and exact title "No Comment" unchanged. Preserve portrait 9:16.

The small fluffy white winged pastry thief at lower left must match the story: it cannot bite people, and its mouth is a narrow drinking-straw tube. Remove the pink cat tongue and normal biting cat mouth. Give it one slender pale drinking-straw-like proboscis extending gently downward into the cinnamon pastry, visibly sipping icing. It is still fluffy, white and cat-sized with small wings, cute and harmless. Do not give it fangs or extra limbs. Change only this little creature's mouth, keeping its scale, position and all surrounding elements the same. No new lettering; story title remains rendered exactly once.
cover.selection: The exact title is rendered once, Marnie's clipboard is ordinary, and the corrected sugarwing sips through a narrow tube. The superseded cover candidate remains outside the package.

character.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create a professional landscape character reference sheet, 1536x1024, for MARNIE in the story NO COMMENT. Reference image 1 establishes Marnie's accepted identity, hairstyle, clothing and painterly style; use that same woman, not the three background girls.

Exact readable header text: "Marnie" and "No Comment". Neat small view labels if useful: "Front", "Side", "Back", "Expressions", "Props". A coherent oil-painted reference sheet on quiet warm ivory background, using the cover's broad Canadian Group of Seven inspired opaque strokes, connected shadows and restrained selective impasto. No glossy photorealism or anime.

Show same ordinary adult woman in early forties, warm olive complexion, short dark brown wavy bob with grey temples, distinctive brows, same face/body in ALL panels. Same charcoal blazer, cream buttoned blouse, charcoal trousers, sensible flat black lace-up shoes in ALL full-body panels. Include three full-body views front, side and rear plus one three-quarter working pose with ordinary clipboard tucked to chest and comb in hand. Add three readable face expression studies: practical concentration, rueful embarrassment, quiet affection. Include small prop studies of ordinary clipboard with metal clip and small black comb. No powers from Marnie, no supernatural clipboard, no invented weapons or badges. Keep limbs correct, shoes consistent, panels clearly separated with breathing room. Label both character and exact story title; no duplicate full cover image.
character.selection: Same identity, charcoal blazer/trousers, cream blouse, comb and sensible shoes across front/side/back/working views and expression studies. Marnie and No Comment are legible. Appearance details beyond the prose are artistic interpretation.

location.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create a landscape location reference oil painting, 1536x1024, of Bell's Bakery and the small paved square outside, from the finished story "No Comment". Reference image 1 is STYLE ONLY, not orchard setting: Canadian Group of Seven inspired oil painting, broad rhythmic opaque colour/value masses, varied directional strokes, quieter passages, selective impasto, simplified architecture, connected shadows. Natural late morning sunlight, cream stone, muted sage, dusty brick, warm grey paving; avoid glossy details and automatic orange/blue contrast.

A modest modern neighbourhood bakery faces a little square. Fresh intact front window shows a cake fridge and pastry counter inside. Beside it a clearly visible mesh screen doorway. Muted sage awning above. One small ornamental tree near the square. Two ordinary pavement tables close to the bakery, with a spacious empty end of the square extending rightward, enough space for a manager to carry a cake away from the doorway. A tray-sized rectangular decorated cake on a normal serving board rests on one table: miniature sugar shop window on top, simple icing emblems on front. This is a PORTABLE display cake, never coffee-table sized. A folded ordinary baker's cloth nearby. Bakery sign reads exactly "Bell's Bakery", no other required text.

The place itself is the subject: no principal character portraits, no attack or fall, no huge rose explosion, no army, no magical infrastructure. Small unobtrusive hints of reopening, such as a ribbon beside the doorway, are welcome. Show the relation between bakery window, screen door, outdoor cake table, tree and empty square clearly, with generous coherent paving and practical walking space. Novelistic, warm, inviting, plausible neighbourhood place.
location.correction_prompt:
Make a selected correction of this location painting for "No Comment". Preserve the bakery architecture, exact readable sign "Bell's Bakery", sage awning, fresh shop window, cake fridge, mesh screen doorway, folded baker's cloth, two pavement tables, sunlit cream stone square, broad oil strokes, color palette, connected shadows and the generous empty end of the square. Same landscape 1536x1024. Do not add people, creatures, attack, extra lettering or a different building.

Two focused story-fidelity corrections:
1. The ornamental tree is described as little. Reduce the oversized tall tree to a young ornamental tree about 3 metres tall, with slender trunk and a modest airy canopy that is completely visible in the image, reaching about the bakery awning height. Keep it rooted in the same small planter area beside the right-hand table. Restore natural sky and distant background where its old giant crown was. Keep the pleasant tree-shadow rhythm, scaled to the smaller tree.
2. On the left-hand pavement table, make the cake clearly a portable baking-tray-sized rectangular FROSTED SHEET CAKE on a normal thin serving board. The sugar miniature of the bakery's intact shop window sits on TOP of the cake; it is a light small centrepiece, not the entire cake. Show a distinct cake base with a pale icing surface and three small abstract icing emblems along its front. It should be a plausible two-handed load for an ordinary adult. Keep the model window and cake subordinate to the setting, with coherent perspective and intact table legs.

Maintain clear walking room from the mesh doorway into the empty paved square. No stylistic modernization, no glossy lens effects. This is a quiet setting reference painting, not a climactic scene.
location.selection: Selected correction reduces the ornamental tree and distinguishes the portable frosted cake from its sugar window. It preserves the screen doorway, outdoor tables and empty paved square. The original painting is retained separately.
